title: 第621章 仙药到手暴怒的古云武第620章 偶遇古云武林轩的坏主意
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 就在他们“密谋”的这段时间里，那边的战斗已经接近尾声。
古云武的实力实在太恐怖了，短短时间十个散修就只剩下三人了。
那魁梧大汉虽然修为也达到了半步仙王，但与古云武之间的差距却如同天堑。
无论是哪方面，他都全方位地被碾压。
又是一声闷响，又一个散修被古云武一掌拍中胸口，整个胸腔都塌陷下去，倒飞出去数十丈，落地时已经没了气息。
剩下的最后两名散修，顿时吓得魂飞魄散，再也没有了战意。
不知谁喊了一声，两人同时转身，朝着不同的方向疯狂逃窜。
“一群蝼蚁还想逃？”
古云武冷笑一声，“可笑！”
他身形一闪，瞬间追上一人，一掌将其毙命。
然后又化作一道流光，追向另一人……
短短几个呼吸间，又两人纷纷被击杀。
“哼，一群蝼蚁，这就是与本神子作对的下场！”他看着那些散修的尸体，不屑道。
随后他收回目光，转身朝着那四株天金碧叶仙草走去。
“神子威武！”
那两名古神教弟子连忙拍马屁，“那几个散修也敢与师兄争抢宝物，真是找死。”
古云武得意地笑了笑，走到凹地边缘，蹲下身来，仔细打量着那四株仙药。
他的眼中满是满意之色。
天金碧叶仙草，好东西啊！
四株全部炼化，他的修为说不定能再进一步，距离真正的仙王境更近一分。
他伸出手，就要去采摘。
然而就在他的手即将触碰到仙药的那一刻。
一道金色的身影突然出现，以快到不可思议的速度落在了他和那两名弟子中间。
古云武脸色一变，下意识地想要出手。
但那只金色的猴子却根本没有攻击他的意思，而是猛地伸出爪子，往地面上一按。
一道璀璨的金色光芒从那猴子的爪下绽放出来，瞬间在地面上蔓延开来，形成一道道复杂的阵纹。
那阵纹散发着强烈的空间波动，正以肉眼可见的速度扩散，将古云武和那两名古神教弟子笼罩其中。
古云武瞳孔骤缩，“找死！”
他怒喝一声，手中凝聚出一道银色光芒，就要朝那只猴子轰去。
但他刚一动，一道凌厉的剑光便从天而降，朝他劈来。
古云武不得不收手抵挡那道剑光。
“谁！竟敢偷袭本神子！”
他怒吼一声，随后抬头一看，只见一个身穿淡青色长袍的青年站在空中，手中握着一柄长剑，正冷冷地看着他。
“是你！”古云武瞬间认出了对方。
正是之前在外面那个和叶冰凝穿着同色系衣服、还敢当众让他滚的小子！
“小子，你找死！”古云武瞬间暴怒。
“敢算计本神子，我看你是活腻了！”
林轩嘴角微微上扬：“呵呵，就凭你，还不配。”
content_en:
While they were "plotting", the battle over there was coming to an end.
Gu Yunwu's strength was so terrifying that in a short period of time, only three of the ten casual cultivators were left.
Although the burly man had reached the half-step Immortal King level, the gap between him and Gu Yunwu was like a chasm.
No matter which aspect, he was crushed in all aspects.
"Pfft——!"
There was another muffled sound, and another casual cultivator was hit in the chest by Gu Yunwu's palm. His entire chest collapsed and he flew backwards for dozens of feet. When he landed on the ground, he was already out of breath.
The last two remaining casual cultivators were immediately frightened to death and no longer had the will to fight.
"Escape!"
Someone shouted, and the two of them turned around at the same time and ran away wildly in different directions.
"A bunch of ants still want to escape?"
Gu Yunwu sneered, "It's ridiculous!"
With a flash of his body, he caught up with someone and killed him with one palm.
Then it turned into a stream of light and chased another person...
In just a few breaths, two more people were killed one after another.
"Hmph, a bunch of ants, this is what happens when you go against this Son of God!" He looked at the corpses of those casual cultivators and said with disdain.
Then he withdrew his gaze, turned around and walked towards the four golden-leaf immortal grasses.
"The Son of God is mighty!"
The two disciples of the Ancient God Cult quickly flattered him, "Those casual cultivators dare to compete with senior brothers for treasures. They are really looking for death."
Gu Yunwu smiled proudly, walked to the edge of the depression, squatted down, and carefully looked at the four fairy medicine plants.
His eyes were full of satisfaction.
Sky-Golden Green Leaves Immortal Grass, what a good thing!
After all four plants have been refined, his cultivation may be able to take a further step forward, and he may be one step closer to the true Immortal King realm.
He stretched out his hand to pick it.
However, at the moment when his hand was about to touch the elixir.
A golden figure suddenly appeared and landed between him and the two disciples at an incredible speed.
"Huh?!"
Gu Yunwu's expression changed, and he subconsciously wanted to take action.
But the golden monkey had no intention of attacking him at all. Instead, it suddenly stretched out its paw and pressed it on the ground.
“Buzz——!”
A bright golden light bloomed from under the monkey's claws and instantly spread on the ground, forming complex formations.
The formation emits strong spatial fluctuations and is spreading at a speed visible to the naked eye, enveloping Gu Yunwu and the two disciples of the Ancient God Sect.
"Array?!"
Gu Yunwu's pupils shrank suddenly, "Seeking death!"
He shouted angrily, condensed a silver light in his hand, and was about to blast it at the monkey.
But as soon as he moved, a sharp sword light fell from the sky and struck him.
Gu Yunwu had to stop his hand to resist the sword light.
"Who! How dare you sneak attack on this son of God!"
He roared angrily, then looked up and saw a young man wearing a light blue robe standing in the air, holding a long sword in his hand, looking at him coldly.
"It's you!" Gu Yunwu recognized the other party instantly.
It was the boy who was wearing the same color clothes as Ye Binning outside before and dared to tell him to get lost in public!
"Boy, you are looking for death!" Gu Yunwu became furious instantly.
"If you dare to scheme against me, this son of God, I think you are tired of living!"
The corners of Lin Xuan's mouth raised slightly: "Haha, you are not worthy enough."
title_en: Chapter 621: Gu Yunwu becomes furious after receiving the elixir Chapter 620: Encountering Gu Yunwu Linxuan’s bad idea
